examples: A roofing company had 4,200 dead leads in ServiceTitan. We turned on our AI agent. 30 days later: 127 conversations, 34 booked appointments, 8 closed deals. Revenue from leads they already paid for.

Hot take: You don't need more leads. You need to work the ones you already have. Most businesses have THOUSANDS of untouched contacts sitting in their CRM. That's not a lead problem — it's a follow-up problem.
We analyzed 50 home service companies' CRMs last quarter. Average dead lead count: 3,400. Average leads contacted in the last 90 days: 12%. That's 88% of your marketing spend sitting idle.
I called 100 home service companies last week pretending to be a customer. 37 went to voicemail. 12 had hold times over 2 minutes. That's 49% of businesses literally turning away customers.
Your competitor answers in 2 seconds. You send them to voicemail. Who gets the job? This isn't a hypothetical. 78% of customers go with whoever answers first.
A dental practice installed our AI phone agent on a Friday. By Monday, it had answered 23 weekend calls they would have missed. 9 became appointments. ROI in 3 days.

optimization_tips: Start with retargeting only — cheapest and highest intent
Install LinkedIn Insight Tag on your website ASAP
Test Lead Gen Forms vs landing page — forms usually convert better on LinkedIn
Refresh creative every 2 weeks to avoid ad fatigue
Exclude current customers and existing pipeline from targeting
Run ads Tuesday-Thursday only (cheapest days on LinkedIn)
Kill any campaign with CPL over $40 after 1000 impressions
